latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — simplifies adding royalty-free music to your videos in seconds.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos up to 500MB and get background music matched to the video mood.
- No editing software needed; just describe your request (e.g., "add upbeat background music") and receive a music-backed video in 30–60 seconds.
- Secure cloud processing with automatic token and session setup.
- Avoid YouTube copyright strikes and monetization blocks—ideal for creators, marketers, and social media users.
- Supports batch uploads, timeline previews, and direct export to MP4.
- Clear feedback for errors, status, and remaining credits.
